title: A defect in an earlier branch commit is inside the branch-aware default target
task: This branch adds pagination and fixes singular labels. R1: paginate(items, page, page_size) in paginate.py returns the items of 1-based page number page, that is items[(page - 1) * page_size : page * page_size]; page 1 is the first page. R2: plural_label(count, noun) in labels.py returns "1 <noun>" for count 1 and "<count> <noun>s" otherwise.
